highlights.title_zh: braindecode 纳入 SleepFM 睡眠基础模型，并统一预训练模型的通道处理层
highlights.title_en: braindecode Adds SleepFM Foundation Models and a Unified Channel Layer
highlights.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 7 日推进 7 次提交：#1106 把 SleepFM 基础模型与睡眠分期模型收进库内，做睡眠脑电的团队第一次可以在同一套 API 里加载这类权重；#1241 把所有预训练模型的通道处理收敛成统一的 channel_strategy，跨模型（CBraMod、MAPA、CSBrain、BrainOmni）切换时不必再各自实现通道对齐与缺失通道逻辑；#1248/#1247 继续清理权重来源与键名。对复现 EEG 基础模型的人来说，接口正在快速定型：建议锁定 commit，并检查自己写的 channel 适配代码是否已被上游取代。

highlights.title_zh: 硅谷初创 Bridge Neurotech 推出经颅超声非侵入脑机接口，启动首个人体研究
highlights.title_en: Bridge Neurotech Launches Transcranial Ultrasound BCI and Its First Human Study
highlights.brief: 中文科技号「惠科技」10 月 7 日 20:39 报道：硅谷初创 Bridge Neurotech 结束隐身，与 Butterfly Network 签多年研发合作，做「功能性超声成像＋AI 神经解码」的脑机平台，官方强调不开颅、颅内不植入，靠超声穿颅取信号。同日宣布首个人体研究（加州雷德伍德城）并已招募受试者；投资方包括 General Catalyst、reMind Capital、Sunflower Capital 与 Scott Sandell。经百度检索到另一篇独立报道《超声脑机新秀 Bridge 挑战 Merge》佐证同一事实链。对做非侵入式路线的团队，这是 EEG/fNIRS 之外值得跟踪的第三条路径：理论上能在不手术的前提下拿到比 EEG 更深的脑区信号；但项目仅处首个人体研究阶段，信号稳定性与长期安全性尚未验证。

highlights.title_zh: MNELAB 新增设置导入导出与更多 XDF 单位支持
highlights.title_en: MNELAB Adds Settings Import/Export and Broader XDF Unit Support
highlights.brief: MNELAB（MNE-Python 的图形界面）在 v1.6.0 发布次日继续推进可复现性：#707 让设置可以导出成文件再导入，实验室可以把统一的默认参数、路径与显示偏好分发给新同学或复制到计算节点；#709 扩充 XDF 单位支持，降低从第三方采集设备导入时被错误换算的风险。对以 GUI 做日常清理、又需要「同一套流程跑全组数据」的团队，这两项直接减少口口相传的配置差异；建议连同 v1.6.0 的 pipeline JSON 一起纳入版本管理。

items.title_zh: 硅谷初创 Bridge Neurotech 推出经颅超声非侵入脑机接口，启动首个人体研究
items.title_en: Bridge Neurotech Launches Transcranial Ultrasound BCI and Its First Human Study
bullets_zh: 10 月 7 日结束隐身：与上市超声芯片公司 Butterfly Network 达成为期多年的研发战略合作，含技术授权费、里程碑款与硬件采购。
官方称路线完全非侵入——不开颅、颅内不植入任何器件，靠超声穿颅采集脑活动并用 AI 解码神经信号。
同步官宣首个人体研究（加州雷德伍德城）并已开放受试者招募；投资方含 General Catalyst、reMind Capital、Sunflower Capital 及 Scott Sandell。
bullets_en: Ended stealth on Oct 7 with a multi-year R&D partnership with listed ultrasound-chip maker Butterfly Network, covering licence fees, milestone payments and hardware purchases.
Pitched as fully non-invasive: no craniotomy and nothing implanted inside the skull, using ultrasound through the skull plus AI neural decoding.
Announced its first human study in Redwood City, California with subject recruitment open; backers include General Catalyst, reMind Capital, Sunflower Capital and Scott Sandell.
items.brief: 中文科技号「惠科技」10 月 7 日 20:39 报道：硅谷初创 Bridge Neurotech 结束隐身，与 Butterfly Network 签多年研发合作，做「功能性超声成像＋AI 神经解码」的脑机平台，官方强调不开颅、颅内不植入，靠超声穿颅取信号。同日宣布首个人体研究（加州雷德伍德城）并已招募受试者；投资方包括 General Catalyst、reMind Capital、Sunflower Capital 与 Scott Sandell。经百度检索到另一篇独立报道《超声脑机新秀 Bridge 挑战 Merge》佐证同一事实链。对做非侵入式路线的团队，这是 EEG/fNIRS 之外值得跟踪的第三条路径：理论上能在不手术的前提下拿到比 EEG 更深的脑区信号；但项目仅处首个人体研究阶段，信号稳定性与长期安全性尚未验证。
items.brief_en: Reported on Oct 7 (20:39 CST) via a Bilibili tech account: Bridge Neurotech exited stealth with a multi-year R&D deal with Butterfly Network for a functional-ultrasound, AI-decoded BCI it calls fully non-invasive — no craniotomy, nothing implanted. Its first human study in Redwood City is recruiting; an independent Chinese report corroborates the story.
items.raw_excerpt: 「10月7日…Bridge Neurotech宣布结束隐身运营状态，同时官宣与超声芯片上市公司Butterfly Network达成多年研发战略合作…完全非侵入，不需要开颅手术，也不用在颅内植入任何器件…Bridge同步官宣启动该超声脑机接口的首个人体研究，试验地点设在加州雷德伍德城，目前已经开启受试者招募工作。」
items.why_valuable: EEG/fNIRS 之外的第三条非侵入路线进入人体研究，值得持续跟踪其数据。

items.title_zh: braindecode 纳入 SleepFM 睡眠基础模型，并统一预训练模型的通道处理层
items.title_en: braindecode Adds SleepFM Foundation Models and a Unified Channel Layer
bullets_zh: #1106 引入 SleepFM 基础模型与睡眠分期模型，使脑电/多导睡眠数据的预训练权重可在同一框架内直接调用。
#1241 为所有预训练模型统一 channel_strategy：通道对齐、重命名与缺失通道处理集中到一层，跨模型切换不再各写一套。
同日 #1248 让 MAPA 直接加载 braindecode 托管权重并删除 fc1/fc2 键名映射，#1247 给 CSBrain 增加 head_drop_prob 并写明 checkpoint 键名。
bullets_en: #1106 adds SleepFM foundation and sleep-staging models so pretrained EEG/sleep weights load inside the same framework.
#1241 unifies channel_strategy across every pretrained model, centralising channel alignment, renaming and missing-channel handling.
Same day #1248 loads braindecode-hosted MAPA weights and drops the fc1/fc2 key mapping; #1247 adds head_drop_prob to CSBrain and documents checkpoint key names.
items.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 7 日推进 7 次提交：#1106 把 SleepFM 基础模型与睡眠分期模型收进库内，做睡眠脑电的团队第一次可以在同一套 API 里加载这类权重；#1241 把所有预训练模型的通道处理收敛成统一的 channel_strategy，跨模型（CBraMod、MAPA、CSBrain、BrainOmni）切换时不必再各自实现通道对齐与缺失通道逻辑；#1248/#1247 继续清理权重来源与键名。对复现 EEG 基础模型的人来说，接口正在快速定型：建议锁定 commit，并检查自己写的 channel 适配代码是否已被上游取代。
items.brief_en: braindecode landed 7 commits on Oct 7: #1106 integrates SleepFM foundation and sleep-staging models; #1241 unifies channel_strategy across all pretrained models so channel alignment and missing-channel handling live in one place; #1248/#1247 clean up weight sources and key names. Pin a commit while the API settles.
items.raw_excerpt: "Add SleepFM foundation and sleep-staging models (#1106)" 15:45Z; "Channel layer: one channel_strategy for every pretrained model (#1241)" 20:48Z; "MAINT MAPA: load the braindecode-hosted weights, drop the fc1/fc2 key mapping (#1248)" 20:11Z.
items.why_valuable: 睡眠基础模型可直接调用，通道层统一后跨模型复现成本显著下降。

items.title_zh: MNELAB 新增设置导入导出与更多 XDF 单位支持
items.title_en: MNELAB Adds Settings Import/Export and Broader XDF Unit Support
bullets_zh: #707 增加设置（settings）导入／导出，可把偏好与默认参数打包成文件在多台机器或团队内共享。
#709 支持更多 XDF 数据单位，减少外部设备记录格式导入后被错误换算的情况。
紧随 v1.6.0（新增可重放流水线）之后推进，说明该 GUI 正把「可复现」作为主线：配置与流程都可外带。
bullets_en: #707 adds settings import/export so preferences and defaults can be shipped as a file across machines or labs.
#709 supports more XDF units, cutting mis-scaling when importing recordings from external devices.
Landed right after v1.6.0's replayable pipelines, making reproducibility the GUI's main line: both config and workflow are now portable.
items.brief: MNELAB（MNE-Python 的图形界面）在 v1.6.0 发布次日继续推进可复现性：#707 让设置可以导出成文件再导入，实验室可以把统一的默认参数、路径与显示偏好分发给新同学或复制到计算节点；#709 扩充 XDF 单位支持，降低从第三方采集设备导入时被错误换算的风险。对以 GUI 做日常清理、又需要「同一套流程跑全组数据」的团队，这两项直接减少口口相传的配置差异；建议连同 v1.6.0 的 pipeline JSON 一起纳入版本管理。
items.brief_en: One day after v1.6.0's replayable pipelines, MNELAB added settings import/export (#707) so defaults can be shared across machines and labs, plus broader XDF unit support (#709) to avoid mis-scaling on import from third-party devices — both cut configuration drift in group workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: "Add support for settings import/export (#707)" committed 2026-10-07T09:31Z; "Support more XDF units (#709)" 11:58Z; "Improve docstrings and changelog consistency (#708)" 10:14Z — all after release v1.6.0 (2026-10-06T13:09Z).
items.why_valuable: 配置可版本化分发，配合 v1.6 pipeline 能真正统一全组预处理环境。

items.title_zh: Neurotech Costbook：给脑机硬件项目做预算的开源「成本手册」
items.title_en: Neurotech Costbook, an Open Evidence-Based Budgeting Tool for Neurotech Builds
bullets_zh: 以 COSTBOOK.md 为产品本体（约 27 KB），面向创始人、PI、工程负责人与注册团队，按场景给出所需现金、内部人力、条件性支出与敏感性分析。
明确区分证据等级：当前供应商／FDA／机构报价是直接锚点，带日期的文献只是代理值，派生值必须写出公式，条件性数值在分支触发前不计入基础现金。
附 calculator/calc.py，可用 --validate、--self-test 与 --scenario garage 复算模型，数字不是拍脑袋。
bullets_en: COSTBOOK.md (~27 KB) is the product, aimed at founders, PIs, engineering leads and regulatory teams: cash, internal labour, conditional exposure and sensitivities per scenario.
It grades evidence: current vendor/FDA/institutional numbers are anchors, dated literature is a proxy, derived values show their formula, conditional values stay out of base cash until triggered.
calculator/calc.py can be rerun with --validate, --self-test and --scenario garage so the model is reproducible rather than hand-waved.
items.brief: 新建仓库 Neurotech Costbook（2026-10-07）把「做一个脑机硬件项目到底要花多少钱」写成可复算的手册：按场景列出所需现金、内部人力工时、条件性敞口与敏感性，并给出下一步该向谁询价。最有价值的是它对证据的分级纪律——现期供应商/FDA/机构数字才算锚点，过期文献只能当代理值，派生数必须展示公式，条件支出在分支触发前不进基础现金；配套 calc.py 支持 --validate/--self-test 复算。对准备立项、写预算或评估报价合理性的团队（含高校工程中心）是稀缺的横向参考，但注意其锚点以美国市场为主。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-10-07, Neurotech Costbook turns neurotech hardware budgeting into a reproducible handbook: per-scenario cash, internal labour, conditional exposure and sensitivities, with strict evidence grading (current vendor/FDA anchors vs dated literature proxies) and calculator/calc.py supporting --validate/--self-test. Anchors are US-centric.
items.raw_excerpt: "`COSTBOOK.md` is the product. It is a practical budgeting tool for founders, PIs, engineering leads and regulatory teams… Current vendor/FDA/institutional numbers are direct anchors. Dated literature is a proxy, not a current quote. Derived values show their formula… python calculator/calc.py --validate / --self-test / --scenario garage".
items.why_valuable: 立项与询价时可直接复算的横向成本参考，且证据分级方法可迁移。

items.title_zh: MindFlex BCI：改造版脑电帽经 Arduino/BLE 送 Python 实时识别并驱动遥控车
items.title_en: MindFlex BCI: Hacked EEG Headset, Arduino/BLE Transport, ML Driving Commands
bullets_zh: 改造 MindFlex 消费级脑电帽，把原始读数通过 USB 或蓝牙低功耗交给 Arduino，再由 Python 实时分析。
在录制会话上训练多个机器学习模型，将预测结果转成驾驶指令，驱动自制、3D 打印的四电机遥控车。
德英双语 README（各约 9.5 KB）＋硬件照片文档，源自一篇「脑机接口——思维如何控制机器」的学生研究论文实践部分。
bullets_en: A modified consumer MindFlex EEG headset streams its readings to an Arduino over USB or Bluetooth LE, analysed in real time by a Python app.
Several machine-learning models are trained on recorded sessions and their predictions become driving commands for a self-built, 3D-printed four-motor RC car.
Bilingual German/English READMEs (~9.5 KB each) plus hardware photo docs, produced as the practical part of a student research paper on BCI.
items.brief: 新建仓库 mindflex-bci-car（2026-10-07）完整记录了一条低成本非侵入链路：改造 MindFlex 脑电帽→Arduino（USB 或 BLE 无线）→Python 实时分析→在自录数据上训练多个 ML 模型→输出驾驶指令控制自制 3D 打印四电机小车。作者同时给出德英双语长文档与硬件实拍，包含脑电帽改装、供电与固件细节，并附带 BrainGrapher 相关目录用于可视化。虽是学生研究论文的配套工程，但「消费级 EEG 设备协议改造＋无线传输＋在线分类＋执行器」这条链路可复现度高于多数 demo，适合教学或做低成本 BCI 原型的团队当作参考实现。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-10-07, mindflex-bci-car documents a complete low-cost non-invasive chain: hacked MindFlex EEG headset → Arduino over USB/BLE → real-time Python analysis → ML models trained on recorded sessions → commands for a self-built 3D-printed four-motor car, with bilingual docs and hardware photos.
items.raw_excerpt: "A brain-computer interface project: a modified MindFlex EEG headset sends its readings through an Arduino – over USB or wirelessly via Bluetooth LE. A Python application analyses the signals in real time, trains several machine-learning models on recorded sessions and turns their predictions into driving commands for a self-designed, 3D-printed RC car with four motors."
items.why_valuable: 消费级 EEG＋无线传输＋在线分类＋执行器的完整低成本链路，可照做。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 批量性能优化：Epochs.get_data 时间切片与 baseline 向量化
items.title_en: MNE-Python Performance Batch: Faster Epochs.get_data Slicing and Vectorised Baseline
bullets_zh: #14384 调整 Epochs.get_data() 的时间切片顺序，减少大 epoch 数组上的无谓拷贝。
#14377 在指定 picks 时对 baseline 的 rescale 运算做向量化，逐通道循环被批量矩阵运算取代。
#14383 修复加载 eyelink 数据时 _find_overlaps 的排序问题（眼动—脑电联合分析相关）。
bullets_en: #14384 reorders time slicing inside Epochs.get_data() to avoid needless copies on large epoch arrays.
#14377 vectorises baseline rescaling when picks are specified, replacing a per-channel loop with batched array maths.
#14383 fixes sorting in _find_overlaps when loading eyelink data, relevant to combined eye-tracking–EEG pipelines.
items.brief: MNE-Python 在 10 月 7 日合并三项性能与正确性改动：#14384 优化 Epochs.get_data() 的时间切片顺序，减少大数组重复拷贝；#14377 让指定 picks 时的 baseline rescale 走向量化路径；#14383 修掉读取 eyelink 眼动数据时 _find_overlaps 的排序缺陷。对跑大规模被试内交叉验证、或做 EEG＋眼动联合分析的团队，这三项属于「不改结果但省时间／少踩坑」的类型：升级后可直接对比 baseline 校正前后数值是否一致来确认无回归；当前最新发布仍是 v1.13.2，需从 main 获取。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged three perf/correctness changes on Oct 7: faster time slicing in Epochs.get_data() (#14384), vectorised baseline rescaling when picks are given (#14377), and a fix to _find_overlaps sorting for eyelink data (#14383). Latest release is still v1.13.2, so take them from main.
items.raw_excerpt: "PERF: Optimize time slicing order in Epochs.get_data() (#14384)" 2026-10-07T21:24Z; "perf(baseline): vectorize rescale array operations when picks are specified (#14377)" 19:12Z; "Fix sorting in `_find_overlaps` for loading eyelink data (#14383)" 22:18Z.
items.why_valuable: 大规模脑电批处理的实际提速点，且给出可自查的回归验证方式。

items.title_zh: MNE-BIDS 把 MRI 去脸化函数正式公开为 API
items.title_en: MNE-BIDS Makes the MRI Defacing Function a Public API
bullets_zh: #1544 将原先内部的 MRI defacing 函数提升为公开 API（对应 issue #1529），共享影像前的匿名化处理不再依赖私有接口。
对需要向数据平台或合作者提交结构像的实验室意义直接：去脸化步骤可写进正式流程并在版本升级时保持兼容。
#1677 同日补充了遵循 MNE-Python 风格的 agent 指引文档。
bullets_en: #1544 promotes the previously internal MRI defacing function to a public API (see issue #1529), so anonymisation before sharing no longer relies on private interfaces.
Directly useful for labs submitting structural images to archives or collaborators: defacing becomes a documented step that survives version bumps.
#1677 added agent guidance following MNE-Python conventions the same day.
items.brief: MNE-BIDS 把 MRI 去脸化（defacing）从内部函数提升为公开 API（#1544，回应 issue #1529）。此前要在数据共享前做匿名化处理，只能引用未文档化的私有符号，版本一升级就可能失效；现在它成为受支持的正式接口，可以安全写进采集—入库流水线。对同时管理脑电与结构像、需要向 BIDS 数据集或公开仓库提交数据的团队，这是合规链条上少见的「今天就能改脚本」的改进；建议同时固定 mne-bids 版本并记录所用去脸化参数，便于后续复核。
items.brief_en: MNE-BIDS promoted its MRI defacing helper to a public API (#1544, closing issue #1529), so pre-sharing anonymisation no longer depends on undocumented private symbols and stays stable across upgrades — a practical compliance win for labs contributing structural images alongside EEG.
items.raw_excerpt: "ENH: Make MRI defacing function public (cf issue: #1529)  (#1544)" committed 2026-10-07T18:59Z; "Add agent guidance following MNE-Python (#1677)" 16:06Z.
items.why_valuable: 匿名化步骤从私有接口转为受支持 API，共享数据的合规脚本可直接改。

items.title_zh: FieldTrip 修正相位斜指数计算：斜率窗口排除最后一个频点
items.title_en: FieldTrip Excludes the Last Frequency Bin from the Phase-Slope Index Slope Window
bullets_zh: #2610 修改 ft_connectivity_psi，把最后一个频率点从拟合斜率的窗口中剔除。
相位斜指数（PSI）用于抗零相位伪连接，端点频点在斜率回归里权重不稳，会直接影响显著性判断。
对做脑电/脑磁功能连接、并用 PSI 论文数值对标的人：升级后需重跑基准，历史结果可能出现小幅变化。
bullets_en: #2610 changes ft_connectivity_psi to exclude the last frequency point from the window used to fit the slope.
The phase-slope index targets zero-lag spurious connectivity, and edge bins carry unstable weight in the slope regression, affecting significance calls.
Groups benchmarking PSI numbers should rerun baselines after upgrading, since published values may shift slightly.
items.brief: FieldTrip 合并 #2610，调整 ft_connectivity_psi：把最后一个频率点从用于拟合斜率的窗口里排除。相位斜指数是脑电/脑磁功能连接中专门压制零相位伪连接的指标，其数值来自跨频点的斜率回归，端点频点权重不稳，容易让显著性判断出现偏差——这类改动属于方法学层面而非表面修补。因此对以 PSI 为主要结局指标的实验室，升级 FieldTrip 后应重跑关键对照与已发表基准，确认结论未受端点处理影响；同时建议在论文方法段注明所用版本。
items.brief_en: FieldTrip merged #2610, dropping the last frequency bin from the slope-fitting window in ft_connectivity_psi. Since PSI relies on a cross-frequency slope regression, unstable edge bins can sway significance — labs using PSI as a primary outcome should rerun benchmarks after upgrading and report versions.
items.raw_excerpt: "ft_connectivity_psi: exclude the last frequency bin from the slope window (#2610)" — commit 2026-10-07T09:23Z, the repository's only commit in the window (latest release 20251218).
items.why_valuable: 方法学级修正，直接影响 PSI 结果解释，升级前必须重跑基准。
